propositions: BindingRepository must own live, retired, rotation, and alert files and preserve exact byte layout (sorted/indented/trailing-newline JSON) without eager writes on construction.

Rotation persistence failure must leave the sidecar old and live updated with new bytes retaining inline last_get_pass floor, without raising; subsequent saves must converge the sidecar from the retained floor.
Corrupt live JSON must raise ValueError and preserve the file; corrupt retired JSON must fail open, return empty, preserve the file, and attempt deduped alerting.
Persistent failure at rotation tempfile/write/replace, retired write, or live write must leave affected files old and raise (except rotation failures which do not raise); temp files must be cleaned.
Alert persistence failure must not alter the successful state-file result and must be swallowed.
The save operation must attempt rotation persistence before live replacement and remain unconditional even when no in-memory change occurs.
